themes.name: Lantern Meadow
themes.author: kolache
themes.description: A calm painted meadow you read beside, not on top of. Warm paper by day, ink-blue by night, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next and Lexend, one amber lantern ring on the newest reply, the message box and dialogs. Long replies sit in a 70-character reading column with the speaker's name kept in view. No motion. All text measured at 4.5:1 or better on the real pixels behind it.

themes.name: Lantern Path
themes.author: kolache
themes.description: A quiet autumn path. Misty amber mornings on paper, lantern light on walnut at night, a few leaves drifting behind the cards and a calm reading column for long replies. Switches with the time of day. Font: Fraunces (SIL OFL 1.1).

themes.name: Maple's Bramble Cottage
themes.author: kolache
themes.description: A recipe journal on a sunlit kitchen counter. Linen and morning light by day, a lamplit walnut kitchen by night (follows the time of day). Fraunces headings, Nunito text, one sage hand stitch, a book-width reading column for long replies, washi tape on your notes. No motion, no HTML.

themes.name: NEON//GRID
themes.author: kolache
themes.description: Black glass terminal over a rain-slick neon city. Cyan corner brackets on whatever has focus, one neon tube under the top bar, a 70-character reading column for long replies with a pinned speaker line. Finished day (dawn) and night looks; follows the time of day. No HTML needed.

themes.name: Petal OS
themes.author: kolache
themes.description: A pastel pixel desktop: every message, dialog and Home widget is a crisp little window with a title bar and _ [] X buttons, on a soft pixel city. Morning pink by day, plum CRT glow by night (suggests Follow time of day). Pixel fonts throughout: if they are hard to read, set Font back to Inter.

themes.name: Rosalind's Folio
themes.author: kolache
themes.description: A castle library staged like a painted visual novel: candlelit by night, sunlit by day. Long replies set like a book page (about 70 characters a line, pinned speaker, scene-break ornaments), a gilt frame on the page you are reading, and a walnut-and-gilt VN dialogue box. Suggests Follow time of day (07:00 light, 19:00 dark). Fonts: EB Garamond and Cinzel (SIL OFL 1.1).

themes.name: Swiss Poster
themes.author: kolache
themes.description: Swiss poster. Off-white paper by day, black card stock by night, one red. Inter throughout, hairline rules, a 3px rule to open every section, and one red sun sinking behind a ground band on Home. Long replies are set in one 36em column (about 65 characters a line) that the message box and every turn rule share; avatars hang in the margin and the speaker's name stays pinned while you read. Follows the time of day.
